name: Install dependencies with pnpm
description: >-
  pnpm, Node 24 and a frozen-lockfile install. The pnpm store cache is
  read-only everywhere except pushes to main: pull requests and branches
  restore main's entry and never save their own, so cache entries stop
  multiplying per branch.
inputs:
  ffmpeg-github-token:
    description: Optional API-read-only GitHub token for verified FFmpeg assets.
    required: false
    default: ''
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
      with:
        version: 10.34.3
    - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
      with:
        node-version: 24
    - id: store
      shell: bash
      run: echo "path=$(pnpm store path --silent)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    - id: restore
      uses: actions/cache/restore@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
      with:
        path: ${{ steps.store.outputs.path }}
        key: pnpm-store-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          pnpm-store-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
    - shell: bash
      run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      env:
        FFMPEG_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.ffmpeg-github-token }}
    - name: Save the pnpm store (main only)
      if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && steps.restore.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      uses: actions/cache/save@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
      with:
        path: ${{ steps.store.outputs.path }}
        key: pnpm-store-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}

name: CI

# Merge-blocking source and database checks run on GitHub's PR merge candidate,
# not a same-repository branch push. This avoids duplicating the same expensive
# jobs and detects integration failures against the target branch at PR time.
# - pull_request: premerge checks (same-repo and fork PRs);
# - merge_group: synthetic queue candidate, if a queue is enabled later;
# - push main: postmerge verification of each distinct main commit.
# CI runs no browser tests (decision 2026-11-01-1520). Preserve the existing
# protected status-check names.
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '23 3 * * 1'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  # Main commits need unique groups: a new pending run must not evict an older
  # pending run (cancel-in-progress: false alone does not guarantee that).
  group: ui-policy-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && format('-{0}', github.run_id) || '' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

env:
  # Existing accounting/admission suites exercise the hosted deployment.
  # The self-hosted image workflow separately runs the default community mode.
  MIKKA_EDITION: cloud
  # A cache restore that fails (e.g. the account's cache egress limit) would
  # otherwise hang for actions/cache's 10-minute default before falling back
  # to a normal install, which outlasts the short jobs' own timeouts.
  SEGMENT_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_MINS: '2'
  # Ephemeral CI registration fixtures share one loopback IP. Keep finite
  # limits while leaving the production defaults at 5 signups/IP/hour.
  MIKKA_SIGNUP_IP_HOURLY: '1000'
  MIKKA_SIGNUP_GLOBAL_HOURLY: '10000'
  MIKKA_VERIFICATION_IP_HOURLY: '1000'
  MIKKA_VERIFICATION_GLOBAL_HOURLY: '10000'

jobs:
  changes:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-selection.yml

  cloud-secret-access:
    name: Cloud credential access (OIDC)
    # Credential checks do not run for documentation-only changes.
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.docs_only != 'true' && github.event_name == 'push' && github.repository == 'alexj11324/Mikka' && github.ref != 'refs/heads/wabi/issue-116-migration-prerequisite'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Read one credential through Infisical workload identity
        uses: Infisical/secrets-action@d2e351f16c6ca20d17c85e6c992e04bdeb64e87d # v1.0.18
        with:
          method: oidc
          identity-id: 2cf9fa19-b9db-4c08-8ca0-b31859f2cbac
          oidc-audience: mikka-infisical
          project-id: 89850d6a-f020-4936-863e-df77380dfe40
          env-slug: staging
          secret-path: /vercel
          secret-name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
          include-imports: false
      - name: Verify cloud credential against its issuer
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'JS'
          if (!process.env.COMPOSIO_API_KEY) throw new Error('Cloud credential was not injected')
          const response = await fetch('https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3.1/webhook_subscriptions', {
            headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.COMPOSIO_API_KEY },
            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
          })
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Issuer rejected cloud credential: HTTP ${response.status}`)
          console.log('Infisical OIDC and issuer credential validation succeeded')
          JS

  ui-policy-full:
    name: Core unit checks
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true'
    # Fixed standard Linux image; host namespace/security policy stays unchanged.
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: ci-build-secret-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
      MIKKA_DATABASE_URL: postgres://mikka:mikka@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/pnpm-install
        with:
          ffmpeg-github-token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Run selected core tasks through Nx Core
        run: node scripts/ci/run-units.mjs core
        env:
          CI_UNITS: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.units }}

  ui-policy-integrations:
    name: Integration unit checks
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.integration == 'true'
    # Fixed standard Linux image; host namespace/security policy stays unchanged.
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: ci-build-secret-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
      MIKKA_DATABASE_URL: postgres://mikka:mikka@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/pnpm-install
        with:
          ffmpeg-github-token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Run selected integration tasks through Nx Core
        run: node scripts/ci/run-units.mjs integration
        env:
          CI_UNITS: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.units }}

  source-checks:
    name: Source checks
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.source == 'true'
    # Fixed standard Linux image; host namespace/security policy stays unchanged.
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: ci-build-secret-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
      MIKKA_DATABASE_URL: postgres://mikka:mikka@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/pnpm-install
        with:
          ffmpeg-github-token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Shadow selection against full baseline scenarios
        run: node scripts/ci/shadow.mjs
      - run: pnpm check:cloud-boundary
      - name: Verify all production release credentials use existing Infisical OIDC
        run: node --test scripts/mobile-ota-credentials.test.mjs scripts/release/apple-credentials.test.mjs
        if: always()
      - name: Verify production auth and lease acceptance drivers without credentials
        run: node --test scripts/acceptance/auth-audit-production.test.mjs scripts/acceptance/cloud-lease-audit.test.mjs scripts/acceptance/cloud-lease-recovery.test.mjs scripts/acceptance/shared-account-queue.test.mjs scripts/ops/production-smoke.test.mjs
        if: always()
      - run: pnpm lint:code
        if: always()
      - run: node apps/api/scripts/generate-routes.mjs --check
        if: always()
      - run: pnpm lint:runtime
        if: always()
      - run: pnpm test:api
        if: always()
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/frontend test
        if: always()
      - run: pnpm typecheck
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
        if: always()
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/protocol typecheck
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/mobile typecheck

      - name: Audit business UI composition
        run: pnpm --silent lint:ui --json > ui-audit.json
      - name: Show audit summary
        if: always()
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e '
            import fs from "node:fs";
            if (fs.existsSync("ui-audit.json")) {
              const audit = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("ui-audit.json", "utf8"));
              const summary = `## Strict UI policy\n\n${audit.files} business files style-scanned; ${audit.interactionFiles} files interaction-scanned (including business blocks); ${audit.errors} errors. ${audit.libraryFiles} component-library files excluded from style checks only. No upstream source verification.\n\n` + Object.entries(audit.counts).map(([rule, count]) => `- ${rule}: ${count}`).join("\n") + "\n";
              console.log(summary);
              fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, summary);
            }
          '
      - name: Upload detailed audit
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ui-policy-audit
          path: ui-audit.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  daemon-checks:
    name: Daemon checks
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.daemon == 'true'
    # Fixed standard Linux image; host namespace/security policy stays unchanged.
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: ci-build-secret-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
      MIKKA_DATABASE_URL: postgres://mikka:mikka@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/pnpm-install
        with:
          ffmpeg-github-token: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Daemon unit and transport regression tests
        run: pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon exec vitest run --no-cache --reporter=default --reporter=github-actions --reporter=json --outputFile.json="$RUNNER_TEMP/pr13-daemon-unit-results.json"
      - name: Existing mailbox CLI integration tests
        run: pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon test:mailbox-cli
      # Part of the daemon's own test script, which otherwise runs only when main publishes.
      - name: Daemon repository identity, GitHub credential and trusted endpoint tests
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon test:repository-identity
          pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon test:github-credentials
          pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon test:trusted-endpoint
      - name: Local computer authority through actual daemon and adapter protocol
        run: pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon exec node --import tsx --test test/local-computer-adapters.node-test.ts test/local-computer-daemon.node-test.ts src/computer/proxy.test.mjs
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          MIKKA_TEST_MODE: '1'
      - name: Preserve daemon unit evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: pr13-cli-diagnostics-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pr13-daemon-unit-results.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon typecheck
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon build
        id: daemon-package
      - run: pnpm --filter @mikka/daemon test:package
        env:
          MIKKA_DAEMON_DIST_DIR: ${{ steps.daemon-package.outputs.package-directory }}

  # PR specializations are reusable jobs so the stable gate can require their
  # actual conclusions. Main retains its existing independent release workflows.
  image-checks:
    needs: changes
    if: github.event_name != 'push' && needs.changes.outputs.image == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/self-hosted-image.yml
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

  desktop-checks:
    needs: changes
    if: github.event_name != 'push' && needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/desktop.yml

  analytics-checks:
    needs: changes
    if: github.event_name != 'push' && needs.changes.outputs.analytics == 'true'
    uses: ./.github/workflows/analytics-ssr.yml

  ui-policy:
    # The required check name. It reports success when only documentation
    # changed; otherwise it mirrors the full suite's result.
    name: UI policy (strict)
    needs: [changes, ui-policy-full, ui-policy-integrations, source-checks, daemon-checks, image-checks, desktop-checks, analytics-checks]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Require every selected source, unit and daemon job
        env:
          CHANGES_RESULT: ${{ needs.changes.result }}
          EXPECT_CORE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.core }}
          EXPECT_INTEGRATION: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.integration }}
          EXPECT_SOURCE: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.source }}
          EXPECT_DAEMON: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.daemon }}
          EXPECT_IMAGE: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.changes.outputs.image == 'true' }}
          EXPECT_DESKTOP: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true' }}
          EXPECT_ANALYTICS: ${{ github.event_name != 'push' && needs.changes.outputs.analytics == 'true' }}
          IMAGE: ${{ needs.image-checks.result }}
          DESKTOP: ${{ needs.desktop-checks.result }}
          ANALYTICS: ${{ needs.analytics-checks.result }}
          CORE: ${{ needs.ui-policy-full.result }}
          INTEGRATION: ${{ needs.ui-policy-integrations.result }}
          SOURCE: ${{ needs.source-checks.result }}
          DAEMON: ${{ needs.daemon-checks.result }}
        run: |
          test "$CHANGES_RESULT" = success
          for name in CORE INTEGRATION SOURCE DAEMON IMAGE DESKTOP ANALYTICS; do
            expected="EXPECT_$name"
            case "${!expected}" in
              true) test "${!name}" = success ;;
              false) test "${!name}" = skipped ;;
              *) exit 1 ;;
            esac
          done
          echo 'All selected source/unit/daemon jobs succeeded.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        if: always()
      - name: Record actual completed job timings
        if: always()
        run: node scripts/ci/summary.mjs
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  browser-tests-full:
    # CI runs no browser tests (decision 2026-11-01-1520); this job keeps the
    # database suites that the required check names cover.
    name: Database checks (${{ matrix.shard }})
    needs: changes
    if: needs.changes.result == 'success' && needs.changes.outputs.db == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.changes.outputs.db_matrix) }}
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:17
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: e2e
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: e2e-local-only
          POSTGRES_DB: mikka_e2e
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U e2e -d mikka_e2e"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
    env:
      CI: 'true'
      REQUIRE_DB: '1'
      DB_TEST_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
      DB_TEST_SELECTED: ${{ needs.changes.outputs.db_suites }}
      MIKKA_TEST_DB_PORT: '5432'
      E2E_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      MIKKA_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://e2e:e2e-local-only@127.0.0.1:5432/mikka_e2e
      BETTER_AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3100
      MIKKA_TEST_DEPLOYMENT_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      MIKKA_TEST_ENVIRONMENT_FILE: .cache/e2e/environment.json
      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: ./.github/actions/pnpm-install
        with:
          ffmpeg-github-token: ${{ github.token }}
      # The .deb files apt downloads for the packages below, keyed on the package
      # list and the runner image (a new image can carry newer dependencies).
      # Read-only except on pushes to main, like the pnpm store.
      - name: Name the native dependency package cache
        id: native-debs-key
        run: echo "key=native-debs-v1-$ImageOS-$ImageVersion-${{ runner.arch }}-bubblewrap-socat-ripgrep" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Restore native dependency packages
        id: native-debs
        uses: actions/cache/restore@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ~/native-debs
          key: ${{ steps.native-debs-key.outputs.key }}
      - name: Install native dependencies for the CLI approval database roundtrip
        # A stalled Ubuntu mirror once held apt for the rest of the job
        # (2026-11-01, run 41257416436). Fail this step instead of the job.
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          packages=(bubblewrap socat ripgrep)
          if compgen -G "$HOME/native-debs/*.deb" > /dev/null && sudo dpkg -i "$HOME"/native-debs/*.deb && command -v bwrap socat rg > /dev/null; then
            echo "Installed ${packages[*]} from the cached packages"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "No usable cached packages; installing ${packages[*]} from the Ubuntu mirror"
          apt_options=(-o Acquire::Retries=3 -o Acquire::http::Timeout=30 -o Acquire::https::Timeout=30)
          sudo apt-get "${apt_options[@]}" update
          sudo apt-get clean
          sudo apt-get "${apt_options[@]}" install -y -f "${packages[@]}"
          command -v bwrap socat rg > /dev/null
          rm -rf "$HOME/native-debs" && mkdir -p "$HOME/native-debs"
          if compgen -G "/var/cache/apt/archives/*.deb" > /dev/null; then cp /var/cache/apt/archives/*.deb "$HOME/native-debs/"; fi
      - name: Save native dependency packages (main only)
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && steps.native-debs.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: ~/native-debs
          key: ${{ steps.native-debs-key.outputs.key }}
      - name: Generate ephemeral test-only auth secret
        run: |
          node --input-type=commonjs - <<'NODE'
          const { appendFileSync, writeSync } = require('node:fs')
          const secret = require('node:crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex')
          writeSync(1, `::add-mask::${secret}\n`)
          appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET=${secret}\n`)
          NODE
      - name: Bootstrap empty database using tracked migrations only
        run: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/migrate-empty-db.test.mjs
        env:
          MIGRATION_BOOTSTRAP_CI: '1'
      - run: pnpm test:e2e:setup
      - name: Bind the disposable test environment to the exact checkout
        run: node scripts/test-accounts/bootstrap.mjs --output .cache/e2e/environment.json
      - name: Verify local execution identities and repository records (isolated Postgres)
        if: startsWith(matrix.shard, '1/')
        run: node --conditions=react-server --import ./tests/support/server-only-loader.mjs --import tsx --test tests/local-runtime.integration.ts
      - name: Verify thread sharing, membership and privacy against isolated database
        if: startsWith(matrix.shard, '1/')
        run: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --conditions=react-server --import ./tests/support/server-only-loader.mjs --import tsx --test tests/issue-threads.integration.ts
      - name: Required DB suites (temporary Postgres 17, no skips)
        run: pnpm test:db
        env:
          REQUIRE_DB: '1'
          RUN_DISPATCH_DB_TESTS: '1'

          docker tag mikka-self-hosted:check "$image:$GITHUB_SHA"

          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then

            docker push "$image:$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          elif [ "$GITHUB_REF" = refs/heads/main ]; then
            docker tag mikka-self-hosted:check "$image:latest"
            docker push "$image:latest"
          fi
      - name: Retain startup diagnostics on failure
        if: failure()
        run: docker compose logs --no-color --tail=150
      - name: Stop disposable services
        if: always()
        run: docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans
